Allowed, subject to all just exceptions.
2. Application stands disposed of.

3. By way of the present petition, the petitioners seek quashing of FIR bearing no. 456/2021,
registered at Police Station Baba Haridas Nagar, Dwarka, Delhi, for the commission of offence punishable under Sections 498A/406/34 of Indian Penal Code, 1860 (hereafter IPC ) and the proceedings emanating therefrom.

entities.text: Police Station Baba Haridas Nagar, Dwarka
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: 4. The petitioners and respondent no. 2 are present before this Court and have been identified by their counsels and concerned Investigating Officer This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 03/12/2025 at 21:31:56 (IO) from Police Station Baba Haridas Nagar, Dwarka, Delhi.
5. Brief facts of the present case are that the marriage between the petitioner no.1 and respondent no. 2 was solemnized on 13.04.2016, as per Hindu rites and customs.
It is stated that one child was born out of the said wedlock.

Due to certain matrimonial discord and differences, both the parties Raghubeer Singh & Ors vs State(Nct Of Delhi) & Anr on 1 December, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/128233058/
1 started residing separately since 2021.

sentences.text: It is stated that on the complaint of respondent no. 2, the present FIR was registered against the petitioners.

6. During pendency of the case, both the parties had amicably settled their disputes before the Principal Judge, Family Courts, New Delhi District, Patiala House, New Delhi vide Settlement Deed dated 04.03.2024.

entities.text: Principal Judge, Family Courts, New Delhi District, Patiala House, New Delhi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
It is stated that the parties are living together since 06.05.2024.
7.

On a query made by this Court, respondent no.2, who has been identified by the IO, has categorically stated that she has entered into compromise out of her own free will and without any pressure, coercion or threat.
Respondent no. 2 further states she has no objection if the present FIR is quashed.
8. In view of the above fact that the parties have amicably resolved their differences of their own free will, and without any coercion, no useful purpose will be served by continuing the proceedings

,
rather the same would create further acrimony between them.
It would thus be in interest of justice to quash the abovementioned FIR and the proceedings pursuant thereto.
There is no legal impediment in quashing the FIR in question.

9. Accordingly, FIR bearing no. 456/2021, registered at Police Station Baba Haridas Nagar,
South-West District, Delhi, for the commission of offence punishable under Sections 498A/406/34 of IPC and all This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 03/12/2025 at 21:31:56 consequential proceedings emanating therefrom are quashed.
10. In view of above, the present petition stands disposed of.
11. The order be uploaded on the website forthwith.
DR. SWARANA KANTA SHARMA, J DECEMBER 01, 2025/
